intent.raw: $refine how can we correlate KPI with grant actions to generate business intelligence; what statistical techniques can we use; clarify how grant run data becomes ontology intelligence over time.
intent.objective: Produce a strategy proposal for a governed KPI-action correlation and ontology-backed business intelligence refinement before mutating canonical artifacts.
intent.operator_sentence: Refine the KPI-action correlation and ontology BI architecture for GoldenQuill.

route_menu.context_hint: The target combines analytics method selection, event/DAG projection, ontology promotion, and future-pipeline intelligence.

items.label: Event fact ontology bridge
items.description: Project accepted grant-work events into action facts, correlate them with KPI response windows, then promote only governed insight candidates.

items.label: Dashboard-first BI
items.description: Build dashboards over raw KPI aggregates first and infer ontology concepts later.

items.label: Causal-model-first
items.description: Start with causal inference contracts before enough event and KPI data quality exists.

technique_overlays.trigger: The unclear part is the hidden path from grant actions to DAG, analytic facts, KPI response windows, ontology candidates, and future grant-work intelligence.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The route must name action events, analytic projections, KPI windows, ontology candidate records, and approved feedback packets.

technique_overlays.trigger: Several statistical methods are plausible but require different sample sizes, assumptions, and authority labels.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Rejected or deferred methods must be recorded with method assumptions, data maturity gates, and interpretation limits.

technique_overlays.trigger: Correlation claims need a tiny fixture that proves the system can distinguish association, confounding, and approved ontology knowledge.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The plan must include a fixture with one apparent action-KPI relationship that is blocked or qualified by bias/confounding evidence.

technique_overlays.trigger: Approved BI findings should return through future grant-work context while rejected, low-confidence, or private findings remain residue.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The final synthesis must distinguish approved intelligence, candidate insight, low-confidence observation, and private residue.

technique_overlays.trigger: Grant actions and outcomes can contain org-scoped feedback, funder relationships, staff work patterns, and private application evidence.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Analytics and ontology mappings must preserve org scope, redaction/generalization, and owner-decision boundaries.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The target crosses analytics, grant operations, ontology governance, and implementation data contracts.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Sibling role review would reduce method and authority blind spots before canonical mutation.

roles.purpose: Evaluate statistical technique options, assumptions, sample-size gates, and interpretation limits.
roles.owns: statistical method findings and data maturity risks

roles.purpose: Map grant actions, lifecycle stages, outcome events, cycle costs, and KPI response windows.
roles.owns: grant-run data capture and feature projection findings

roles.purpose: Verify how analytic findings become ontology candidates without premature approved reuse.
roles.owns: ontology bridge, owner approval, privacy, and contradiction-path findings

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Confirm before running delegated subagents or runtime-backed Refine stages.

steps.name: Context Builder evidence baseline
stop_conditions: block if target inventory cannot resolve DAG, KPI, event, ontology, and reuse contracts

steps.name: Invoke Define KPI-action intelligence concepts
stop_conditions: block if concepts collapse correlation, causation, ontology candidate, and approved reuse

steps.name: Interrogation refine-review
stop_conditions: block if KPI correlation is treated as promotion authority

steps.name: Research decision
stop_conditions: ask before external research if a named statistics or grant-analytics gap appears

steps.name: Distill statistical technique alternatives
convergence_criteria: Preserve source truth and KPI denominator semantics
Label correlation, causal evidence, and candidate intelligence differently
Support small-sample fixture validation before production analytics
Allow ontology feedback only after governance and owner approval
stop_conditions: flag methods whose assumptions cannot be validated by current data

steps.name: Invoke Design KPI-action ontology BI architecture
stop_conditions: block if design lacks action fact, KPI window, method registry, ontology bridge, or feedback-loop contracts

steps.name: Interrogation refine-design-review
stop_conditions: block if ontology candidates can bypass governance or privacy approval

steps.name: Distill Repair
stop_conditions: block unresolved statistical authority or ontology promotion errors before planning

steps.name: Invoke Plan BI project split
stop_conditions: plan must split into self-contained development projects with statistical validation fixtures

steps.name: Final Interrogation and Refine synthesis
stop_conditions: final synthesis must name next route and avoid applying canonical changes without approval

gates.condition: REFINE-DISPATCH.json validates against dispatch.schema.yml and technique governance.
Runtime-backed stages and delegated subagents require explicit confirmation after the strategy proposal.
No canonical docs are mutated during strategy-proposal mode.
Correlation, model output, and KPI threshold cannot approve reusable ontology knowledge.
Org-scoped grant feedback and action data remain private unless redacted/generalized and owner-approved.

authority.lifecycle: GoldenQuill owns grant workflow lifecycle; Refine owns only this strategy proposal.
authority.execution: Task Session owns future implementation execution from an approved work-pack.
authority.validation: dispatch-spec validates route shape; GoldenQuill validators validate event, DAG, KPI, method, ontology, and governance fixtures.
authority.evidence: GrantWorkEvent, EventProjectionReceipt, GrantOutcomeEvent, KPIObservation, and ApprovedReusePacket remain evidence handles.
authority.memory: Approved BI intelligence returns through approved reuse packets only.
authority.promotion: Ontology Vault layer and OwnerDecision own promotion authority and approved allowed uses.

state_namespaces.write_policy: write only generated proposal artifacts under the run folder before confirmation

promotion_splits.rule: analytics may propose or qualify intelligence but never approve reuse

promotion_guardrails: No canonical SPEC, architecture, domain, workflow, event, mapping, operation, or test artifact is mutated in strategy-proposal mode.
No statistical method output creates approved allowed uses.
No ontology projection writes approved reusable knowledge without owner decision.
No future pipeline recommendation consumes private or low-confidence findings as approved intelligence.
